description_en: Shares a target data source with a specified DataWorks workspace or specified users
description_zh: 分享目标数据源至指定DataWorks工作空间或指定用户
name: SetDataSourceShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the target data source belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the target data source to be shared
parameters.help_zh: 待分享的目标数据源名称
parameters.name: datasource_name

parameters.help_en:
The environment to which the target data source belongs. Valid values:
0: development environment.
1: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
0：开发环境。
1：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace with which you want to share the target data source. After the data source is shared, all members of the workspace can view or use the target data source. Use the JSON array format. Example: [{"projectId":1000,"permission":"WRITE","sharedName":"PX_DATAHUB1.shared_name"}].
Parameter description:
projectId: the ID of the workspace with which you want to share the target data source.
permission: the permission mode. Valid values: READ and WRITE. READ indicates that all members of the specified workspace can only read data from the target data source but cannot modify the data. WRITE indicates that all members of the specified workspace can modify data in the target data source.
sharedName: the name of the data source to be shared
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要分享目标数据源的DataWorks工作空间。分享后，该工作空间的所有成员均可查看或使用目标数据源。使用JSONARRAY格式。[{"projectId":1000,"permission":"WRITE","sharedName":"PX_DATAHUB1.shared_name"}]，
参数说明如下：
projectId：需要分享目标数据源的工作空间ID。
permission：支持READ（读取）和WRITE（写入）两种模式权限。READ（读取）表示指定工作空间的所有成员仅可以读取目标数据源的数据，但是不能修改该数据；WRITE（写入）表示指定工作空间的所有成员可以修改目标数据源的数据。
sharedName：待分享的数据源名称
parameters.name: project_permissions

parameters.help_en:
The users with whom you want to share the target data source. After the data source is shared, the specified users can view or use the target data source. Use the JSON array format. Example: [{"projectId":10000,"users":[{"userId":"276184575345452131","permission":"WRITE"}],"sharedName":"PX_DATAHUB1.shared_name"}].
Parameter description:
projectId: the ID of the DataWorks workspace. This indicates that the users with whom you want to share the target data source can view or use the target data source only in this workspace.
userId: the ID of the user with whom you want to share the target data source.
permission: the permission mode. Valid values: READ and WRITE. READ indicates that the specified user can only read data from the target data source but cannot modify the data. WRITE indicates that the specified user can modify data in the target data source.
sharedName: the name of the data source to be shared.

If both ProjectPermissions and UserPermissions are empty, this operation does not make any modifications. If neither is empty, both UserPermissions and ProjectPermissions take effect
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要分享目标数据源的用户。分享后，该用户可查看或使用目标数据源。使用JSONARRAY格式。[{"projectId":10000,"users":[{"userId":"276184575345452131","permission":"WRITE"}],"sharedName":"PX_DATAHUB1.shared_name"}]，
参数说明如下：
projectId：指定DataWorks工作空间的ID。表示需要分享目标数据源的用户仅在该工作空间下可查看或使用目标数据源。
userId：需要分享目标数据源的用户ID。
permission：支持READ（读取）和WRITE（写入）两种模式权限。READ（读取）表示指定的用户仅可以读取目标数据源的数据，但是不能修改该数据；WRITE（写入）表示指定的用户可以修改目标数据源的数据。
sharedName：待分享的数据源名称。

ProjectPermissions和UserPermissions如果都为空，则该接口不会做任何修改。如果都不为空，则既会UserPermissions生效，ProjectPermissions也会生效
parameters.name: user_permissions

Data.description_en: The returned data for sharing the target data source
Data.description_zh: 分享目标数据源的返回数据

Message.description_en: The description of the cause for the failure to share the target data source. If the target data source is shared, the value of this parameter is empty
Message.description_zh: 分享目标数据源失败后的原因描述。如果分享目标数据源成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The result status of sharing the target data source. Valid values:
success: The target data source was shared.
fail: The target data source failed to be shared. You can check the Message parameter to locate the cause of the failure
Status.description_zh:
分享目标数据源的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示目标数据源分享成功。
fail：表示目标数据源分享失败。您可以查看Message参数定位失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues when an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。用于出现错误后定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
